label: Произведение
description: A 10-sentence usage card for произведение (work, opus).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Произведение' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the predicate. 'Известное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'искусства' is a genitive complement.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Произведение' is the accusative direct object of 'написал'. As an inanimate neuter noun it equals the nominative, and 'новое' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Произведения' takes the genitive after the negated 'не знаю'. 'Этого' is the agreeing neuter genitive form.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об произведении' uses the prepositional form 'произведении' after 'об' to discuss the work. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'восхищаться'. 'Произведением' takes the instrumental because the verb governs that case, meaning to admire the work. 'Этим' agrees in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'благодаря'. 'Произведению' takes the dative because 'благодаря' governs that case, meaning thanks to the work. 'Этому' agrees in the dative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Произведения' takes the genitive because 'без' requires it, meaning without this work. 'Этого' is the agreeing neuter genitive form.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'посвятить'. 'Произведению' takes the dative because 'посвятить' governs that case, meaning to devote a lesson to the work. A useful frame.

missions.phrase: Его произведения переведены на многие языки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Произведения' is the nominative plural subject. 'Его' shows the author, and 'переведены' is the short passive participle in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'много'. 'Произведений' takes the genitive plural because 'много' requires it. 'Ранних' is the agreeing genitive plural adjective.
